description: This Java source file defines the 'PackingSession' class, which manages the packing process within an order shipment system. It includes methods for adding items, creating shipments and packages, issuing items, and handling related events, with integration to OFBiz framework components.

classes.name: PackingSession
classes.description: Main class managing the packing process, including item management, shipment creation, package handling, and event processing.

classes.name: PackingEvent
classes.description: Referenced but not defined in this file; used for event handling within PackingSession.

classes.name: PackingSessionLine
classes.description: Referenced but not defined in this file; represents individual packing lines within a session.

classes.name: ItemDisplay
classes.description: Inner class representing display information for items in the packing session.

methods.name: addOrIncreaseLine
methods.description: Adds or updates a packing line with specified order, product, quantity, and package info.

methods.name: findLine
methods.description: Finds a specific packing session line based on order, product, inventory, and package details.

methods.name: createPackLineItem
methods.description: Creates a new packing line item based on reservation check results.

methods.name: getPackedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total packed quantity for given order, product, and package parameters.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the packing session, creating shipment, packages, issuing items, and updating statuses.

methods.name: checkReservations
methods.description: Verifies that packed quantities match reserved quantities before completing shipment.

methods.name: runEvents
methods.description: Executes registered packing events based on event code.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues packed items to the created shipment.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record in the system based on session data.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages according to session's package sequence.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates packed items with their respective packages.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates shipment route segments with total weight and UOM.

methods.name: setShipmentToPacked
methods.description: Marks the shipment as packed.

methods.name: setPicklistToPicked
methods.description: Updates picklist status to 'picked'.

methods.name: setPickerOnPicklist
methods.description: Assigns a picker role to the picklist.

methods.name: getTotalWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of all packages.

methods.name: getShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Estimates shipment cost based on various parameters.

methods.name: getPackageWeight
methods.description: Retrieves weight for a specific package.

methods.name: addToPackageWeight
methods.description: Adds weight to a package's total weight.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxType
methods.description: Assigns a box type to a package.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxType
methods.description: Retrieves the box type assigned to a package.
